models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Control Module Software Version does not match (is incompatible to) other Control Modules Software Version
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Update Control Module Software Version(s). VCDS does not do reflashing so updating would presumably need to be done by the factory scan tools using official factory files.
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi A4/S4/RS4/Cabriolet (8K), Audi A5/S5 (8T), Audi A6/S6/RS6/allroad (4F), Audi A8/S8 (4E) or Audi Q7 (4L): Ana Anahtar / Kontrol Ünitesi:
Update MMI Software Version
